title: [FEATURE] WhatsApp channel support (alongside Telegram/Discord)
body:
## Feature Request

Add WhatsApp as an officially supported Claude Code channel, alongside the existing Telegram and Discord integrations.

## Motivation

Telegram and Discord channels allow developers to control Claude Code remotely from their phones. WhatsApp is significantly more widely used globally than either platform, making it a natural addition for developers who prefer or exclusively use WhatsApp.

Community workarounds exist (e.g. [claude-code-whatsapp](https://github.com/gokapso/claude-code-whatsapp), [whatsapp-mcp](https://github.com/verygoodplugins/whatsapp-mcp)) but they are third-party and lack the reliability and feature parity of the official channel plugin.

## Expected Behavior

- `plugin:whatsapp@claude-plugins-official` channel available in settings
- Send messages to Claude Code from WhatsApp
- Receive Claude Code responses in WhatsApp
- Same capability as the Telegram channel (remote control, task delegation)

## Why This Matters

- WhatsApp has 2B+ users globally vs Telegram's ~900M
- Many developers outside North America use WhatsApp as their primary messaging platform
- Parity with community solutions but with official support and maintenance

## Alternatives Considered

- Telegram channel (works but requires Telegram account)
- Third-party bridges (unreliable, require self-hosting)
- Claude iOS Remote Control (different UX, approval-only)

top_comments.author: Rich627
top_comments.body:
I've built this! PR is up: #38105

It's a Claude Code native channel plugin using Baileys (linked-device protocol). Features:

- **QR code pairing** — scan to link, no bot token needed
- **Bidirectional messaging** — text, images, voice, video, documents
- **Permission relay** — approve/deny tool use directly from WhatsApp
- **Access control** — pairing flow, allowlists, group support with mention detection
- **Interactive onboarding** — `/whatsapp:setup` wizard guides through everything
